none.post_processing: posterior, tier assignment and response are post-processing
none.claim: raw features never cross the enclave boundary; LLRs discarded at session end. This is data minimisation, NOT an eps guarantee.

local_inference.post_processing: posterior, tier assignment and response are post-processing
local_inference.adjacency: two signal streams differing in a single interaction of the live user, for one modality
local_inference.protected_output: per-modality clipped log-likelihood-ratio vector released to the fusion engine
local_inference.caveat: the released tier is an inference about the same user whose data is protected; accuracy is therefore bounded by eps

corpus.post_processing: posterior, tier assignment and response are post-processing
corpus.adjacency: add or remove all transcripts of one child from the calibration corpus
corpus.protected_output: released tier-conditional likelihood parameters (means and covariances), computed offline
corpus.caveat: live-user signals are not themselves DP-protected; they are protected architecturally (see PrivacyMode.NONE) and by retention limits

verdict: The 98.6% at eps=1.0 reported in the manuscript is reproducible only under CORPUS-mode DP, where eps protects the children in the calibration corpora. Under local DP applied to the live user's own signals, eps=1.0 gives near-chance accuracy, and the cumulative loss over a 10-interaction session is eps=10 under basic composition. The paper must state which reading it intends.
